tests.reason: The authenticated responses depend on a member's own timeline rows and Index movements; the staging suite does not sign in for gateway probes and hide/delete are writes to the shared production database. The suite runs the route and reader for real over a mocked repository: auth on every endpoint, the Index spotlight, measured-vs-counted influence, digests without special-category items, the pre-migration in-process classification that never lists silent/system rows, filters, cursor, detail, hide-from-ai and delete scoped to the JWT user. The roles suite pins the atlas claim for the new route file.
